note: Read-only full-current-winner cached prediction analysis. Train quantiles use cases ending no later than validation boundary. Both validation years repeatedly reused. No competition labels or model fitting.

method.tail_definition: Outside the pre-validation training 1st/99th percentiles, per generator for generator-specific quantities; min/max exceedance also measured.
method.scale: max(mean(abs(168 supplied hourly prices)),10), identical to current economic rescaling.
method.endpoint_error: An output has one comparison against every opposite-class output globally. Error rate is summed misordered-pair endpoints / summed available-pair endpoints. A pair whose two endpoints both lie in the slice is counted twice; this is separate from the incident union-pair shares.
method.adjustment: Compare tail/in-range endpoint rates within generator x start-month x near-transition x label strata, retain strata with at least20 outputs in each group, standardize using combined endpoint availability. Descriptive composition control, not causal or independent inference.
method.transition_definition: Within +/-2 hours of the first new-state hour in truth labels, diagnostic only.
method.dependency_note: Each year has365 daily-start cases with heavily overlapping168-hour windows; output counts do not represent independent observations. No significance claims are made from the descriptive strata.

split.validation_status: Reused historical development year; not independent holdout.
Reused historical development year; not independent holdout.

conclusions.finding: Economic rescaling removes most hourly-price range extrapolation, but the remaining task is not distribution-shift-free.
conclusions.qualification: These are output fractions from overlapping cases, not independent counts. Normalized prices remain inside historical training minima/maxima in both years; distribution differences can persist within that support.

conclusions.finding: High absolute price scale is not a stable explanation for current errors after rescaling.
conclusions.evidence: Generator/month/transition/label-standardized tail-vs-inrange endpoint error ratios: rawprice1.035/0.853 and logscale0.816/0.649 for2021/2022. Logscale common-strata coverage is only24% in2021, so that adjustment is particularly limited.

conclusions.finding: Near the local economic decision boundary is a stable hard regime beyond simple composition effects.
conclusions.evidence: Absolute normalized local margin<0.1 covers99019/100988 outputs (11.53%/11.76%), with incident-error enrichment1.896/1.981 and controlled endpoint-error ratios2.137/2.356. Common-strata endpoint coverage74.1%/83.4%.
conclusions.qualification: The local price-water-value proxy is not the complete hydraulic opportunity cost. Effects are associations; true-label transition status is used only for diagnosis.

conclusions.finding: Normalized weekly price volatility is an unresolved but stronger2022 effect.
conclusions.evidence: Outside training1–99% volatility range:20/32 cases (5.48%/8.77%); incident-error enrichment1.183/1.820; controlled error ratios1.178/2.043. In2022,3.84% of cases even exceed the historical min/max range.
conclusions.qualification: Only20/32 overlapping case starts; year-specific, season-sensitive evidence rather than a broad proof of generalization failure.

conclusions.finding: Local normalized water values show residual shift but aggregate and matched difficulty disagree.
conclusions.evidence: 13.25%/12.76% outputs outside training1–99% water-value ranges;5.09%/5.17% outside min/max. Aggregate error enrichment0.794/0.698, matched endpoint ratios1.955/1.614 with47.1%/44.4% common-strata coverage.
conclusions.qualification: Composition confounding and incomplete overlap matter. Do not claim these tails dominate total errors or are a proven bottleneck.

conclusions.finding: Low/high local storage and inflow tails do not produce one stable cross-year error explanation.
conclusions.evidence: Storage standardized ratios0.984/1.070 with limited coverage; inflow ratios1.202/0.326 with only1.4% common-strata coverage in2022.

falsifiable_training_experiment.technique: Moderate input-dependent sample reweighting of near-economic-boundary hours; no new model features.
falsifiable_training_experiment.hypothesis: Finite model capacity and the training objective underallocate attention to economically ambiguous hours. Giving both labels in this input-defined region1.5x weight may improve ranking there without changing the conditional-label optimum in the unlimited-capacity limit.
falsifiable_training_experiment.fixed_definition: weight=1.5 when abs((price-local_terminal_water_value)/max(mean(abs(168 prices)),10))<0.1; otherwise1.0. Same training-only feature computation and ordering as current pipeline. Use both positive and negative labels; do not use true transition masks to assign weights.
falsifiable_training_experiment.comparison: One prespecified weight factor and boundary, with current winning rescaled tree hyperparameters, frozen stopping-count protocol and ensemble recipe. Select on2021; advance unchanged to2022. Compare both full-ensemble micro AUC and near-boundary endpoint errors, checking generator/month regressions.
falsifiable_training_experiment.falsification: Reject if it fails to improve selected full-ensemble micro AUC on2021 or does not retain improvement under the frozen2022 comparison, even if near-boundary AUC alone improves.
limits: Weighted finite-model fits can trade easy-region performance for hard-region gains; overall micro AUC is decisive.
The economic proxy omits downstream hydraulic opportunity costs and start/stop constraints.
This is one targeted diagnostic experiment, not a recommendation for a broad weighting sweep on reused validation years.

deferred_augmentation_note: Unstructured price, water-value or inflow noise may change the true optimizer decision, so arbitrary feature perturbation is not demonstrably label-preserving. The observed stable boundary regime supports a bounded weighting experiment more directly than generic jitter.
